scope: Original Nemesis base game, standard semi-cooperative play on the basic board with the six original characters. Solo/cooperative modes, Intruder-player mode, alternative board, campaign material and expansions excluded.
review_method: Read the complete 3125-line authoritative source snapshot and complete 398-line summary. Checked original PDF page 23 embedded component symbols and their diagram placement for all four crafting recipes. Did not consult questions, keys, reader outputs, grades, coverage reports or other audit artifacts.
assessment: The substantive teaching text matches the authoritative standard-core rules across setup, action economy, exploration, combat, contamination, rooms, survival and endgame. Two localized quick-reference statements are inaccurate or ambiguous relative to the detailed rules; neither requires a structural rewrite. No major defect or important missing standard-core procedure found.

findings.title: Key-numbers reference incorrectly says ship destruction kills everyone
findings.claim: 8 Fire markers, 8 Malfunction markers — a 9th of either ends the game with everyone dead.
findings.issue: The destruction kills all characters aboard, including hibernating characters, but does not kill characters who already launched in Escape Pods. The detailed End of the game section correctly limits the deaths to characters aboard. The unqualified quick-reference wording could incorrectly eliminate an evacuated survivor and prevent their victory check.

source_references.rule: Ship destruction kills all characters on board; if at least one character survived, including one evacuated in an Escape Pod, proceed to Victory Check.

findings.suggested_correction: Replace everyone dead with everyone still aboard dead, retaining Victory Check for evacuated survivors.

findings.title: Combat quick reference should preserve Action-card targeting qualifier
findings.claim: Intruder Attack: target = Character with fewest cards in hand.
findings.issue: The detailed Intruder Attack rule specifies fewest Action cards for selecting among characters, whereas the quick reference says cards without qualification. Contamination cards are explicitly not Action cards. This is inconsistent with the summary's correct detailed attack-targeting instruction and can select a different target when hand compositions differ. This wording also occurs in the source manual's own abbreviated last-page reference; the explicit detailed targeting rule is the basis for this minor clarification, rather than treating the source shorthand as a separate rule.

source_references.rule: Select the character with fewest Action cards; ties use first-player order, with separate Surprise Attack and Escape targets.
Contamination cards are not Action cards.
The abbreviated source reference itself uses fewest cards shorthand.

findings.suggested_correction: Say fewest Action cards in hand, using the detailed rule; keep the already-correct detailed targeting exceptions.
